ModMetaData.name: Threat Pause Votes
ModMetaData.author: Angela Fisher
ModMetaData.description: When Multiplayer auto-pauses for a letter, only receiving colonies request Paused (0) votes. Other players keep their selected speeds. Uses synchronized vote commands and optional Quest Faction Fix recipient routing. Preserves map/world scope and automatic-pause threshold. All players must install the same version and use Lowest Wins time control.
